title: Backend, Frontend and AI Engineering Quiz
description: Seven questions covering all five question types; 50 points in total.

questions.content:
Which asyncio function runs several awaitables concurrently and returns their results in the order the awaitables were passed?
A. asyncio.sleep
B. asyncio.gather
C. asyncio.wait_for
D. asyncio.run

Which of the following can describe the shape of an object in TypeScript? (Select all that apply)
A. An interface
B. A type alias
C. An enum
D. An inline object type annotation
True or false: every component that calls the same custom React Hook shares one copy of that Hook's state.
True or false: for a cross-origin request that is not a simple request, the browser first sends a preflight OPTIONS request.
Explain what Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is and why it helps an LLM answer questions about a company's private documents.

scoring_points.desc: At question time, relevant documents or chunks are retrieved from an external knowledge source (e.g. a vector database)
The retrieved text is added to the prompt as context, and the LLM generates the answer from it
Benefit: answers are grounded in private or up-to-date data the model was not trained on, without retraining, and hallucination is reduced

questions.content: Describe how the OAuth2 password flow with JWT tokens works in a FastAPI app: what happens when the user logs in, and what happens on later requests?

scoring_points.desc: At login the client sends the username and password (as form data) to a token endpoint
The server checks the password against the stored hash and returns a signed JWT access token with an expiry time

Later requests send the token in the Authorization: Bearer header; the server verifies the signature and expiry and gets the current user from it (e.g. in a dependency), rejecting invalid tokens with 401

questions.content: Write a Python function `async def fetch_all(urls, fetch)` that calls the async function `fetch(url)` for every URL concurrently and returns a list of the results in the same order as `urls`. An empty `urls` must return an empty list.
